region: Australia, New Zealand and the United States
business_problem: Lion needed to reduce costs and modernize fragmented HR, IT and risk-support workflows that relied on legacy tools and multiple touchpoints, making routine employee-service tasks slow, complex and harder to manage at scale while protecting frontline operations and customer outcomes.
solution_summary: Lion worked with EY to turn ServiceNow into the enterprise orchestration layer for HR, IT and finance, redesigning the hire-to-retire employee journey before automating it. Discovery workshops mapped workflows and converted pain points into user stories, then rapid prototypes were validated with office, retail and manufacturing staff. ServiceNow became the single front door for requests, knowledge and case tracking, while legacy configurations and channels were consolidated into one platform. EY integrated SAP SuccessFactors to supply HR master data and DocuSign for signature workflows, and used discovery tooling to keep the CMDB current. IT support was migrated from Cherwell into ServiceNow IT Service Management, with ServiceNow IT Operations Management added for operational visibility. Knowledge content, taxonomy and routing models were standardized so ServiceNow NowAssist and virtual agent pilots could answer employee questions, route cases and contain support demand under governed KPI and SLA controls.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow
solution_components.role: Acts as the single employee experience and workflow layer for HR, IT and finance through a unified portal and case-routing model.

solution_components.name: SAP SuccessFactors
solution_components.role: Provides HR master data to the ServiceNow-based employee service workflows.

solution_components.name: DocuSign
solution_components.role: Supplies signature workflows connected to employee-service processes.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM)
solution_components.role: Runs the migrated IT support function with redesigned service catalogs and case routing.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM)
solution_components.role: Supports operational visibility and workstreams aligned to Lion’s technology and operational processes.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow NowAssist
solution_components.role: Powers generative AI assistant pilots that use structured knowledge to contain support requests and speed resolution.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow Virtual Agent
solution_components.role: Handles self-service support interactions in phased pilots built on Lion’s standardized knowledge base.

data_flow: Employee requests enter a single ServiceNow portal, where standardized taxonomy, knowledge and routing logic direct users to self-help content or the right workflow. HR master data flows in from SAP SuccessFactors, signature steps connect through DocuSign, and IT support cases migrated from Cherwell run through ServiceNow ITSM and ITOM. Structured knowledge then supports NowAssist and virtual agent pilots to answer questions and contain requests.
business_outcome: Lion unified employee services on one platform, expanded self-service, improved routing and knowledge access, reduced support effort and operating costs, lowered cyber risk, and demonstrated early GenAI support automation through NowAssist and virtual agent pilots.

architecture_clues: ServiceNow was consolidated as the enterprise orchestration layer for HR, IT and finance.
The platform uses a single portal/front door for HR, IT and finance services.
Lion standardized data, taxonomy and CMDB practices, including a CSDM-aligned taxonomy across HR and IT.
Discovery tooling was used to automatically maintain the CMDB.

AI capabilities are governed and validated against usability KPIs and SLAs before broader rollout.
